Subset Multiply-Imputed SCF Survey Data

Source: R/scf_subset.R
scf_subset.Rd

Subsets a multiply-imputed survey object (svyimputationList) using a logical expression. This function is used to restrict the analysis population while preserving imputation structure.

scf_subset(design, expr)

Arguments

design

A multiply-imputed svrepdesign object (class "svyimputationList") created by scf_load().

expr

A logical expression evaluated inside each implicate's variable frame, e.g., age < 65 & networth > 0.

Value

A new svyimputationList object with all implicates subset identically.

Details

How It Works

  • The logical expression (e.g., age < 65) is evaluated separately within each implicate.

  • Each svrepdesign object is subset using subset().

  • A new svyimputationList is returned, with the same structure as the input.

This function is useful for:

  • Focusing on subpopulations (e.g., non-retirees, borrowers, households with children)

  • Excluding extreme or invalid values

  • Conditioning regression models on specific groups

Inputs

See also

scf_update(), subset(), scf_mean(), scf_MIcombine()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Keep working-age households with positive net worth
scf_working <- scf_subset(scf2022, age < 65 & networth > 0)
scf_mean(scf_working, ~income)
} # }
